messages:
Keisha (CS): Heads-up: Renewal light from NovaLex after steady token spend increase and a few slow summaries. AE asked for a quick mitigation plan they can sign off on. Proposing a rapid compact-int8 canary + split routing and prefix cache. Can we scopedown risks & timelines?
Ralph (SE): Do we have a seq_len distribution? need that to size batching & decide split cutoff.
Min (RE): Pulling 7d sample now. Early read: median 420 tokens, 14% between 1200-3000. Long docs are the cost drivers. Int8 safe for most, but we should test fidelity on their golden set.
Diego (AE): Customer insists on accuracy for legal summaries. Any quality delta must be transparent. They want a 1-page summary and a 48h pilot option.
Keisha (CS): Ok proposed plan: 1) Staging split route: seq_len<=900 -> compact-int8 with prefix_kv, else standard-fp16. 2) 85/10/5 split (compact/standard/dedicated). 3) Run fidelity eval on their 3k golden prompts. 4) One-pager with rollback criteria.
Ralph (SE): I'll push a staging route and collect p50/p95/p99 + token cpm. Snippet for staging: ```route { match: "/v1/summarize" condition: "seq_len <= 900" split: "85/10" models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"] fallback: "dedicated-small" } cache: { prefix_kv: true } batching: { max_batch_ms: 60 }```
Min (RE): I'll run A/B on the golden set: BLEU, embedding drift, and hallucination heuristic. Also testing prefix_kv on vs off. Will flag any case with >1.5% faithfulness drop.
InfraBot: [quota-check] NovaLex account dedicated GPUs available: 1.
Keisha (CS): Timeline: staging perf within 3h, evals in 6h, one-pager draft EOD. Diego will you confirm customer availability for a short pilot opt-in?
Diego (AE): I'll ask them for a 30-min sync tomorrow AM and request 3 failure examples. Also negotiating an optional 2-week pilot they can cancel.
Ralph (SE): Deploying staging route now. Will post dashboard link and a CSV of latency & cost deltas once complete.
Min (RE): Uploaded early evals to /shared/novalex-evals. Preliminary: int8 cohort median latency -14%, p99 -16%, estimated token cost -22%. Quality: 94% of prompts show negligible embedding drift, 4 prompts flagged for reduced specificity on legal citations. Investigating patterns.
Keisha (CS): Good detail. For the one-pager include: expected savings range, latency improvements, top 3 risks, rollback triggers (any tagged legal-case regressions OR >1% CORE metric drop), and pilot opt-in instructions.
Diego (AE): Also include a short checklist for their security/ops: data residency note and how dedicated fallback works. They asked about HSM? remind them this is pilot-only and production can integrate KMS.
Ralph (SE): Logged the staging deploy id dpl_4938271144 at 2025-12-03T09:14Z. Dashboards: p50 down 12%, p95 down 9%, p99 down 16% for pilot cohort. Token cost estimate -20% for pilot cohort.
Min (RE): Details on flagged prompts: three items where compact responses omitted specific statute citations present in fp16 output. Likely due to quantization on long context windows. Suggest routing >1500 tokens to fp16 or add citation-preserve logic in prompt.
Keisha (CS): Action items: Ralph  staging metrics & dashboard link (ETA 1h), Min  final fidelity report + examples (ETA 4h), Diego  customer sync scheduling + pilot ask (ETA EOD), Keisha  one-pager draft (ETA EOD).
Diego (AE): If pilot numbers match estimates, I'll propose a small committed discount to secure renewal. If not, rollback quickly.
Keisha (CS): Thanks team. Keep thread light, capture any customer-facing wording in the one-pager. :thumbsup:
